ast_exclusive_fields.is_async: AST detects async/await; regex does not
ast_exclusive_fields.return_annotation: AST extracts return type hints; regex does not
ast_exclusive_fields.arg_types: AST extracts parameter type annotations; regex does not
ast_exclusive_fields.bases: AST extracts class inheritance chains; regex captures parents partially
ast_exclusive_fields.decorators: AST captures decorators accurately; regex may miss chained/complex decorators

regex_exclusive_advantages.concept_catalog: Regex runs concept-pattern matching for domains beyond structure
regex_exclusive_advantages.language_agnostic: Regex works for all 20+ supported languages without a parser
regex_exclusive_advantages.parse_resilience: Regex does not fail on syntax errors in source files

recommendation: Run ast_extractor first for Python source; fall back to regex on SyntaxError. For all other languages and for concept extraction, use regex (PythonExtractor/language-specific subclass).
